change_requests.title: Create canonical repository skeleton and bootstrap build
change_requests.notes: Initial directory tree, C11 bootstrap target, and test placeholder added on 2026-08-09.

change_requests.title: Install repository gates for notice headers and reserved banned terms
change_requests.notes: Local hooks, a validation script, and a remote workflow gate were added on 2026-08-09.

change_requests.title: Create Phase-0 design scaffold files missing from the initial drop
change_requests.notes: Migration ledger, timing-evidence scaffold, media-format support, and Interface-1 notes added on 2026-08-09.

change_requests.title: Record upstream reference identity for preserved Warajevo material
change_requests.notes: The upstream remote and current HEAD reference were recorded on 2026-08-09.

change_requests.title: Pin toolchain files for the full cross-platform matrix
change_requests.notes: Added explicit Windows x86-64, Linux x86-64, Linux AArch64, macOS AArch64, and macOS x86-64 CMake toolchain files plus configure examples on 2026-08-11.

change_requests.title: Import preserved Warajevo 2.50 source under reference/original-warajevo
change_requests.notes: Imported the source-only tree from upstream HEAD 94f69bd8f4acb6c0c320ae34f9b1c3ee29bc5545 under reference/original-warajevo/source/src/ on 2026-08-11. ROM images and upstream documentation were excluded, and the WZSN build does not reference the import.

change_requests.title: Freeze timing constants and evidence links for the deterministic 48K baseline
change_requests.notes: Frozen the Phase-1 48K PAL integer timing baseline, derived 7 MHz master domain, 224/312/69888 geometry, 448 raster clocks per line, and Phase-1 scheduler ordering with named World of Spectrum evidence on 2026-08-11. ULA-specific contention, interrupt-edge, floating-bus, and raster-fetch evidence remain later phase gates.

change_requests.title: Pin the Fuse Z80 test-suite revision and acquisition instructions
change_requests.notes: Pinned the Fuse source repository master commit 9cbab635f5c9dfdfc5cb769aa89048c7e624d6b7, documented remote acquisition and provenance rules, and added the public corpus placeholder on 2026-08-11. CPU integration and pass/fail evidence remain later implementation work.

change_requests.title: Establish the repository-local private difficult-media corpus directory and publication guard
change_requests.notes: The repository-root WZSN-PRIVATE-TEST-MEDIA directory convention was documented and Git was configured to publish only its README and .gitignore on 2026-08-09.

change_requests.title: Freeze the project workflow rule that no project artifact may be created above the project directory
change_requests.notes: WORKFLOW.md now requires all project artifacts, including private local-only artifacts, to remain within the project directory on 2026-08-09.

change_requests.title: Enforce remote-only build and test execution with private test-artefacts storage
change_requests.notes: Local build/test instructions were removed, the public remote harness contract was added under test-artefacts/README.md, Git was configured to keep all other test-artefacts private, and repository gates now reject local build/test output directories and non-remote CI build/test commands on 2026-08-09.

change_requests.title: Require parser-first validation before any local or remote Windows PowerShell command
change_requests.notes: The tracked helper tools/Test-PowerShellSyntax.ps1 was added, workflow docs now require parser-first validation for local and remote Windows PowerShell commands, and repository gates now require that public rule surface on 2026-08-09.

change_requests.title: Establish the shared remote and hosted-runner harness baseline
change_requests.notes: The tracked tools/harness baseline, remote screenshot capture entry points, hosted GitHub Actions smoke matrix, and public workflow documentation were added on 2026-08-09.

change_requests.title: Add an interactive-session bridge for Windows remote screenshot capture over SSH
change_requests.notes: Added Invoke-WindowsInteractiveScreenshot.ps1, staged both Windows capture scripts into each run-local remote artefact directory, enforced remote parser-first validation, and verified a 393040-byte interactive desktop PNG on windows-11-laptop under run 20260811T185128Z on 2026-08-11.

change_requests.title: Add a parsed Windows remote-exec harness path for toolchain maintenance
change_requests.notes: On 2026-08-09, tools/harness/invoke_remote_windows_powershell.py and the tracked windows-toolchain PowerShell scripts were added so Windows remote maintenance can stay inside the parser-first SSH workflow while recording runs under test-artefacts/remote-runs/.

change_requests.title: Tighten cross-document sanity gates for CR sequencing and workflow metadata
change_requests.notes: On 2026-08-09, repository validation was extended to catch CR next-number drift and remote-machine contract/documentation drift, and the affected public docs were reconciled to the canonical repository URLs and current workflow metadata.

change_requests.title: Implement the Phase-1 portable core foundation
change_requests.notes: Closed the foundation slice for tasks 021-027: fixed-width core types, compile-time width assertions, profile data, canonical master-tick conversion, initial machine ownership, and deterministic same-tick scheduler primitives were implemented and statically reviewed on 2026-08-11.

change_requests.title: Complete the remaining Phase-1 canonical state and headless-core contracts
change_requests.notes: Added explicit little-endian machine-state serialization and FNV-1a hashing over selected deterministic fields on 2026-08-11. Headless runner, trace sink/format, cross-build evidence, and the Phase-1 gate remain open.
